name: Auth0
summary: Managed identity platform (Okta) with social login, MFA, enterprise SSO and organisations.
use_cases: B2B and B2C apps needing enterprise SSO, compliance features, or many identity providers.
tradeoffs: Pricing scales with monthly active users and enterprise features.
User data lives with the vendor; migration requires export planning.
avoid_if: you must self-host identity or keep user data on your own infrastructure.

name: Clerk
summary: Managed authentication and user management with drop-in UI components, strong in the React/Next.js ecosystem.
use_cases: TypeScript/React products wanting polished sign-in UI, organisations and session management quickly.
tradeoffs: Managed-only; user data is stored by the vendor.
Best developer experience is in JavaScript frameworks.
avoid_if: you must self-host or your stack is not JavaScript-centric.

name: Better Auth
summary: Framework-agnostic TypeScript authentication library that stores users in your own database, extended with plugins.
use_cases: TypeScript apps that want to own their auth data and avoid per-user pricing.
tradeoffs: Younger project than established identity providers.
You own security hardening, email delivery and database operations.
avoid_if: you need enterprise SAML SSO and compliance certifications from a vendor.

name: Keycloak
summary: Self-hosted open-source identity and access management server (CNCF) supporting OIDC, SAML and federation.
use_cases: Organisations that must self-host identity, enterprise SSO, LDAP/Active Directory federation.
tradeoffs: A JVM service to run, upgrade and secure.
Admin UI and theming have a learning curve.
avoid_if: you are a tiny team that wants zero identity infrastructure to operate.

name: Auth.js (NextAuth.js)
summary: Open-source authentication library for JavaScript frameworks with many OAuth providers and database adapters.
use_cases: Next.js and other JS apps that need OAuth social login with sessions stored in their own database.
tradeoffs: Fewer built-in features (MFA, organisations) than managed providers.
avoid_if: you need MFA, organisations or enterprise SSO without extra work.
